correctness.rationale: From the pinned RESULT.md, center class sums {e,s+t+u,r+r′} give dim Z=3 and quotient basis s,t,r. Explicit independent brackets [s,t]=r−r′,[s,r]=t−u,[t,r]=u−s span the three-dimensional derived space in all characteristics, so Λ²(K³)≅W. All 3D bivectors are decomposable. A fixed nonzero 2-vector has exactly |SL₂(q)|=q(q²−1) ordered factorizations, while zero has q⁴+q³−q; each quotient pair has q⁶ central lifts. Thus zero=q¹⁰+q⁹−q⁷; each nonzero=q⁹−q⁷; outside W zero. Independent direct algebra enumeration of all 2¹²=4096 pairs at q=2 gives zero fiber 1408, seven nonzero fibers 384 each, and 8 attainable outputs. q=2/3 modular cases are included by the basis argument; finite check is not the infinite proof.
residual_risks: Formal proof is human mathematical reconstruction, not Lean or external certification. q=3 and q=4 verifier source was inspected but its full standalone run is not claimed in this independent audit.

final_claim: For every finite field K=F_q, additive commutator fibers in K[S3] are q¹⁰+q⁹−q⁷ at zero, q⁹−q⁷ at each nonzero element of the 3D derived space, and empty otherwise; Λ²(K[S3]/Z)≅[K[S3],K[S3]]_lin.
